extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic performance figures digitised: Figure 5 (CO2 conversion), Figure 6 (methanol selectivity), Figure 7 (CO selectivity), Figure 8 (methanol selectivity), and Figure 9 (dimethyl ether selectivity). Figures 10–12 are DRIFTS/schematic and were skipped. Dimethyl ether selectivity from Figure 9 is recorded in notes because the target schema has no DME selectivity field. Values are approximate readings from plotted markers; some exact-looking values are constrained by statements in the article text/abstract but still reported as plotted values with qualifier '~'.
